scan.title: Scan your network
scan.description: We'll probe each address in this range for an open SoundBridge shell on port 4444. This can take a little while on larger subnets.

ssdp_confirm.title: SoundBridge discovered
ssdp_confirm.description: Found "{name}" at {host}. Add it to Home Assistant?

reconfigure.title: Change SoundBridge address
reconfigure.description: Currently set to {current}. Enter the new address - the device keeps its existing entities, so anything pointing at it (such as a Music Assistant player) keeps working.

error.no_devices_found: No SoundBridge units were found on that network range.
error.subnet_too_large: That range is too large to scan (max /20).
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't connect, or the device at that address didn't identify itself as a SoundBridge.
